issues.description: File is 2573 lines long. This is significantly above the recommended 500-line threshold. Should be split into multiple focused modules for maintainability and testability.
Utility file is 2495 lines long, indicating too many unrelated utilities in one module. Should be refactored into smaller, specialized utility modules.
File is 2312 lines long. Complex agent flow building logic should be split into smaller functions and modules for better maintainability and testing.
File is 2218 lines long. Contains complex handler logic that should be modularized into smaller, focused handler classes.
Component file is 2095 lines long. This React component should be broken down into smaller, reusable sub-components for better maintainability and reusability.
Utility file is 1943 lines. Large utility files should be split into focused modules (e.g., nodeUtils, componentUtils, dataUtils).
Route 'GET /customer/status' (line 8) lacks enforceAbility middleware. This endpoint is exposed without authentication checks. All routes must use enforceAbility middleware.
Routes 'GET /usage/sync' and 'POST /usage/sync' (lines 33-34) lack enforceAbility middleware. These internal endpoints are exposed without authentication. Must add proper authorization.
Route 'POST /webhooks' (line 37) lacks enforceAbility middleware. Webhook handlers should implement secret verification instead of (or in addition to) enforceAbility.
TODO comment on line 11 'Remove this route' suggests dead code. Either remove the commented route or create a ticket to track its removal.
console.error statement on line 34 in production code. Should use logger.error() instead of console for consistent logging and better observability.
Error silencing on line 35 (commented out next(error)) masks potential issues. Either handle the error properly or use a guard clause to prevent silent failures.

Critical features lack E2E test coverage. Only 2 E2E test files exist (auth.spec.ts, guardrails-settings.spec.ts). Missing tests for: user workflows, chatflow management, API interactions, and sidekick features.
Query on line 40 fetches ChatFlow without checking workspace. Should implement workspace filtering in all service queries to prevent cross-workspace data leakage and improve query performance.
Flowise component nodes lack unit test coverage. No test files found for critical nodes like Agent.ts, handler.ts, utils.ts. Missing tests for component initialization and error handling.
Service contains mixed concerns: document storage, upserting, file management, and vector store integration. Should be refactored into specialized services with clear separation of concerns.
Many service files lack JSDoc comments on exported functions. Critical services like documentstore, chatflows, and billing should have comprehensive documentation for public APIs.
Agent component file is 2530 lines. Complex agent logic should be extracted into smaller modules for graph building, execution, and state management.
File is 1546 lines. Complex chatflow building logic should be split into separate modules for graph construction, validation, and execution.
Service file is 1575 lines containing video generation logic that should be split into separate modules for rendering, encoding, and API interactions.
Multiple large utility files (handler.ts, utils.ts, agents.ts, storageUtils.ts) exceed recommended sizes. Consider extracting common patterns into separate utility libraries.
File is 1105 lines. Graph building logic should be modularized into separate functions for graph construction, validation, and traversal.
Sequential agent implementation is 1090 lines. Should be refactored to extract agent execution logic, state management, and orchestration into separate modules.
File is 1076 lines containing comprehensive Stripe integration. Should be split into separate modules for subscription management, usage tracking, and invoice handling.
Chat model implementation is 1068 lines. Should extract common chat model patterns into a base class to reduce duplication across model implementations.
Chatflows service is 1023 lines with mixed concerns: CRUD operations, execution logic, validation, and messaging. Should be split into separate services.
LLM node implementation is 1013 lines. Should extract LLM selection, configuration, and initialization logic into separate modules.
Microsoft Teams tool implementation is 1669 lines. Complex API interactions should be split into separate modules for channels, messages, and team management.
Jira tool integration is 1172 lines containing multiple API operations. Should extract into separate modules for issue management, workflow, and project operations.
Storage utilities file is 1108 lines. Should be split into separate modules for file operations, storage management, and caching.
Agents utility file is 1079 lines with mixed agent creation, execution, and utility logic. Should be refactored into focused agent factory and executor modules.
Gmail tool implementation is 1079 lines. Complex Gmail API operations should be extracted into separate modules for email management and label operations.
FireCrawl loader is 1047 lines. Web scraping and document processing logic should be split into separate modules.
S3 file loader is 1037 lines. File handling and S3 operations should be extracted into separate utility modules.
Google Drive tool is 982 lines. Drive API operations should be split into separate modules for file, folder, and permission management.
Microsoft Outlook tool is 969 lines. Complex email and calendar operations should be extracted into focused modules.
Limited test coverage for core services. Only 12 test files found across entire server package. Critical services like chatflows, documentstore, and billing need comprehensive test coverage.
Public routes (public-chatflows, public-executions) intentionally lack authentication. These should be thoroughly tested for XSS, CSRF, and data exposure vulnerabilities.
Large utility modules (index.ts, buildAgentflow.ts, buildChatflow.ts) lack comprehensive JSDoc comments explaining exported functions and their parameters.
Node components lack consistent JSDoc documentation. Many complex nodes (Agent.ts, handler.ts) missing parameter documentation and implementation details.
